product_one_liner.value: Typeface orchestrates people, AI agents, and enterprise systems to create and run context-rich, on-brand campaigns for enterprise marketing teams.
product_one_liner.notes: A concise synthesis of the homepage's product description and stated audience.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation has no pricing link and promotes demo/tour calls to action; the referenced pricing URL is reported as returning 404.

named_customers.notes: All three are named in customer testimonials on Typeface's homepage.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn shows 281 employees and Indexed.vc lists the 201–500 band. LinkedIn's separate company-size label is 51–200, so the band is based on the displayed employee count and corroborating range.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Palo Alto, California as headquarters/location and the United States as the country; a funding profile labels San Francisco, so Palo Alto is based on the company LinkedIn profile.

founded_year.notes: Typeface's LinkedIn company profile gives its founding year as 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The mixed-purpose blog includes at least two architecture/build-focused posts by Vishal Sood, the President of R&D: one describes Arc Graph's implementation and another covers the orchestration architecture. It is not a separate engineering-only publication.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation has an API introduction and multiple connector setup/how-to articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists a Senior ML Engineer role.

model_provider.value: Model-agnostic; Typeface names OpenAI GPT-4, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI, and Stability AI Stable Diffusion, and says it supports 20+ foundation models including Gemini 3, Nano Banana, and Veo 3.
model_provider.notes: These are publicly named providers/models; the IT-team page explicitly describes the platform as model-agnostic.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 (and also ISO/IEC 42001:2023, which is outside the requested certification list).

last_funding.notes: Indexed.vc records a $100M Series C in October 2025. Another funding tracker confirms an October 2025 round but labels it Series B+ with an undisclosed amount, so the round's precise classification/amount has conflicting secondary-source reporting.

raised_18mo.notes: The recorded October 2025 funding event falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026, despite disagreement among databases on its classification and amount.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Greenhouse board lists Enterprise Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Typeface announced the next generation of its Orchestration Engine on September 22, 2026, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Julia Vasconcelos's profile lists her as VP, Strategy & Operations at Typeface starting September 2026, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly documented product connectors/integrations; this is an integration signal, not a claim about Typeface's internal CRM stack.
